`${{ user.<column> }}` - every non-sensitive column on _benmore_users for the authenticated session (id, email, role, first_name, last_name, verified, plan, phone, custom signup_fields). Requires `auth: required` on the route (or `auth: optional` with a signed-in caller). Sensitive columns (password_hash, totp_secret, MFA fields) are NEVER in scope - referencing one resolves as unresolved-ref error. Profile columns are caller-written, so they are request input for sql_dynamic text and a credentialed api host (see identity_binding).
`${{ steps.<id>.outputs.first.<col> }}` - top row of a multi-row SELECT. Sugar for `outputs.rows[0].<col>`.
`${{ steps.<id>.outputs.<col> }}` after INSERT … RETURNING <col> - RETURNING values are captured into outputs.

Unresolved `${{ ... }}` references halt the flow with a 500. A respond step answers the `template_unresolved` envelope listing the missing refs (`unresolved_refs`; `available_keys`, what is in scope, only on development apps); any other step fails with the reason `a ${{ }} reference in the step had no value when it ran`. A step that writes, sends or queues checks every reference it reads before it acts. When one has no value the step fails and nothing happens: a `sql` or `sql_dynamic` statement does not run (a reference in `with.params` counts), an `email` or `sms` is not sent, an `enqueue` queues no job, and `notify`, `broadcast`, `api`, `webhook`, `proxy` and `transcribe` do nothing either. Give an optional value a fallback (`${{ params.note || '' }}` or `| default:''`). An email's `unsubscribe_url` is the exception: one that does not resolve only leaves out the List-Unsubscribe header.
